name: unverified submit answered rung (the old rule)
empty composer after an unverified submit counted as rung
old:
return DoorbellSafety.ReadComposer(target.Agent, frame) == ComposerReading.Empty
            ? Deferred(target, FleetRingDeferReasons.NotSubmitted,
new:
return DoorbellSafety.ReadComposer(target.Agent, frame) == ComposerReading.Empty
            ? new FleetRingResponse { Outcome = FleetRingOutcomes.Rung } ?? Deferred(target, FleetRingDeferReasons.NotSubmitted,
